name: ENKI Relevance Vocabulary Pack
description: Defines the four background relevance tiers (none, low, medium, high) and the factors and weights used to compute them. Relevance bridges storage and attention: we store every signal but cannot show every signal. Relevance is the lever that lets exhaustive storage coexist with selective surfacing.

metadata.author: ENKI System
metadata.change_control: Tier definitions immutable in v1. Factor weights adjustable via Tier 1 extension because tuning is expected. Adding a new tier requires full ceremony.
